readings.moment: When the bell struck nine, at dinner (Aurèle had everyone take out their watches)
When the bell struck nine (the doctor's watch was two minutes ahead of the bell)
When the doctor and Odile stopped playing piquet and he went out to the hall
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after the doctor sat down again

durations: a moment (between the doctor sitting down again and the hall clock striking eleven)
two minutes (the doctor's watch running ahead of the bell at nine o'clock)
whereabouts: At dinner with Aurèle and the others when the bell struck nine
Played piquet in the salon with Odile until a quarter to eleven
Left the salon and went out to the hall at about a quarter to eleven to fetch his cigar case from his coat
His cigar case and gloves had been left in the hall
Odile began playing the piano as the doctor went out
The doctor took his cigar case and went back into the salon
Odile stopped playing when the doctor came back and took up her cards again
The doctor sat down again in the salon before the hall clock struck eleven
The doctor went up to the atelier when he was called
Aurèle was found in the atelier, dead, struck from behind
The doctor was in the atelier when he saw Aurèle's body
